name: Enkan no Hitsugi -Tozasareta Yakata to Omoi no Yukue-
original_name: 円環の柩-閉ざされた館と想いのゆくえ-
source:
Claire (name can be changed) and her team of contractors arrived at the island. 

The island was the private property of the wealthy Ainsworth family
whose empty mansion -- popularly known as Coffinhenge -- was damaged by nesting birds. 
Claire and her team were hired to clear away the birds, which they did, 
but the boat that was supposed to take them back to the mainland didn't come. 

As the weather turned sour, they decided to spend the night in Coffinhenge. 

That was the start of strange and tragic events......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE137928.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
克莱尔（化名）和她的承包商团队抵达该岛。

该岛是富裕的安斯沃斯家族的私人财产
他的空宅邸——俗称“棺材阵”——被筑巢的鸟类损坏。
克莱尔和她的团队被雇来清除这些鸟，他们做到了，
但原本要载他们回大陆的船却没有来。

由于天气转坏，他们决定在科芬亨格过夜。

这就是奇怪而悲惨事件的开始……
